author: ThioJoe
description:
Google Chrome and other browsers finally added a long-awaited security feature.

Google Chrome and other chromium-based browsers such as Edge, Opera, Brave, Vivaldi etc just got an important security upgrade. It's called "Device Bound Session Credentials", but don't let the technical terms scare you. Basically the idea is malware can no longer steal your browser cookies and send them to be used by hackers on another device. The cookies are "bound" to that specific device using the TPM module.
